text:
₹4 lakh vanished from a factory. Can you guess where?

An illustrative example many manufacturers will recognise:
• The supplier was short by 20 kg. Not it.
• The machines lost their usual 1.5%. Not it.
• The store room matched the register. Not it.
• The night shift was losing 7.5%, against about 1.5% on the other shifts.

Nobody saw it because yield was checked once a year. A daily yield report for each shift would have shown it in the first week.
